rule.message:
All degree-seeking students must complete the University's Liberal Education requirements .
All freshmen in the College of Science and Engineering must complete CSE 1001: First-Year Experience.
At least 35 upper division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
View Four-year Plans for the College of Science and Engineering. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Integrated Bachelor of Science in Aerospace Engineering & Mechanics and Master of Science in Aerospace Engineering & Mechanics (BAEM/MSAEM). Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
